exam_scheme.note: Selection is conducted in two distinct stages under the Bihar Police Constable Recruitment Rules: (1) Written Examination (OMR objective, 100 marks, Class 10th standard) which is strictly QUALIFYING (min 30% marks) to shortlist candidates in a 1:5 ratio; and (2) Physical Efficiency Test (PET, 100 marks: 50 running, 25 shot put, 25 high jump). CRITICALLY, final merit is prepared EXCLUSIVELY on the basis of marks obtained in the PET (Stage 2), with written exam marks having zero weight in the final merit rank.

stages.stage_name: Stage 1: Written Examination (OMR Objective — Qualifying Only)
stages.source_label: CSBC Bihar Police Constable Recruitment Notice (Advt. No. 01/2025)

papers.paper_name: General Hindi, English, Mathematics, Social Studies, General Science, GK & Current Affairs
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking; 1 mark awarded per correct answer
papers.qualifying_threshold: Mandatory minimum 30% marks; candidates shortlisted in 1:5 ratio for Stage 2 (marks not counted for final merit)

stages.stage_name: Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET) & Physical Standard Test (PST) — Merit Determining
stages.source_label: CSBC Bihar Police Constable Final Selection Notice & PET Standard Regulations

papers.paper_name: Running / Daud (दौड़): Male 1.6 km (max 6 min); Female 1 km (max 5 min)
papers.negative_marking: Failure to complete within time limit results in immediate disqualification
papers.qualifying_threshold: Graded from 20 marks to 50 marks based on time (e.g. <5 mins for male = 50 marks)

papers.paper_name: Shot Put / Gola Phek (गोला फेंक): Male 16 lb shot; Female 12 lb shot
papers.negative_marking: Throws below minimum threshold (16 ft male / 12 ft female) result in disqualification
papers.qualifying_threshold: Graded from 9 to 25 marks based on distance (male >20 ft = 25 marks; female >16 ft = 25 marks)

papers.paper_name: High Jump / Oonchi Kood (ऊंची कूद): Male min 4 ft; Female min 3 ft
papers.negative_marking: Failure to clear minimum height results in disqualification
papers.qualifying_threshold: Graded from 13 to 25 marks based on clearance height (male 5 ft = 25 marks; female 4 ft = 25 marks)

financial_package.note: Constables in Bihar Police and Bihar Special Armed Police (BSAP) are placed in Pay Matrix Level 3 (Basic ₹21,700 – ₹69,100). Entitled to standard state allowances, special police allowances, diet/ration money, and uniform maintenance.
financial_package.pay_source_label: CSBC Bihar Police Constable Final Selection Notice (Advt. No. 01/2025)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 3 entry basic pay of ₹21,700 with standard 58% DA (₹12,586), HRA (8% to 16% depending on posting in Patna, district police lines, or rural police stations: ₹1,736 to ₹3,472), Ration Money Allowance / Diet Allowance (₹3,000/month), Uniform & Washing Allowance (~₹1,000/month), and Medical Allowance (₹1,000). In-hand reflects 10% NPS deduction on Basic+DA (₹3,429) and state police welfare fund contribution.
official_perks: Government barracks or residential quarters in Police Lines, or HRA up to 16%
Monthly Ration Money Allowance / Diet Allowance (₹3,000)
Annual Uniform Allowance and kit maintenance kit
Medical reimbursement under Bihar State Government Health Scheme
Special risk / operational duty allowance when deployed in specialized anti-crime or armed battalions
Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with 14% government contribution
